Our Story

Focused on Heating Control Projects

We build programmable thermostats, smart thermostats, manifold control centers and accessories around real underfloor heating use cases for OEM and project supply. With over 10 years of experience in the HVAC industry, we understand the unique challenges faced by distributors, private-label brands, and project contractors.

Our commitment to quality, flexibility, and efficient delivery has made us a trusted partner for heating control solutions across 40+ markets worldwide.
